name: Wallabag
description: Save articles to read later without ads or tracking, from any device. A private Pocket/Instapaper alternative with export to EPUB/PDF.
compose:
services:
  wallabag:
    image: wallabag/wallabag:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
    environment:
      POPULATE_DATABASE: "false"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/wallabag/data
    restart: unless-stopped
